name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited
summary: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited manufactures, markets, and trades automotive and non-automotive lubricants, and synergy products for use in the automobile and industrial sectors in India and internationally. The company offers automotive lubricants, such as engine oils, driveline fluids, brake fluids and radiator coolants, bike care products, vehicle gear and transmission oils, greases and lubricants for trucks and buses, vehicle coolants and other specialty fluids; and industrial gear and hydraulic oils, as well as lubricants for cars, commercial vehicles, motorcycles and scooters, and tractor farm equipment.
